entities.name: José Reinaldo Tavares
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Reinaldo Carneiro Tavares is a Brazilian engineer and politician. He served as governor of Maranhão, from 2002 to 2007. Was minister of Transport (1986–1990) during José Sarney's presidency. Tavares currently serves as federal deputy.

entities.name: José Reinaldo Tavares
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Reinaldo Carneiro Tavares is a Brazilian engineer and politician. He served as governor of Maranhão, from 2002 to 2007. Was minister of Transport (1986–1990) during José Sarney's presidency. Tavares currently serves as federal deputy.
